note: The census synthesis report: shares of the population with a birth registered (63.0% in 2024, 53.5% in 2014; ages 0-4 39.2%, from 24.8%) and holding the identity card (52.4% of those aged 5 and over). Shares of people registered, not of offices; it names no civil registration or identity system (the only technology named is the census's own CAPI and CATI collection) and says nothing on how a registry office records a birth or death.
